args: mkdir -p .agents/logs && CHROME_REAL="$(ls "$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-"*/chrome-linux*/chrome 2>/dev/null | head -1)" && if [ -n "$CHROME_REAL" ]; then WRAP="$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright/chrome-nosandbox"; printf '#!/bin/bash\nexec "%s" --no-sandbox "$@"\n' "$CHROME_REAL" > "$WRAP"; chmod +x "$WRAP"; exec node .claude/chrome-devtools-mcp-wrapper.js npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --headless --executablePath "$WRAP" 2>>.agents/logs/chrome-devtools-mcp.log; else exec node .claude/chrome-devtools-mcp-wrapper.js npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --headless 2>>.agents/logs/chrome-devtools-mcp.log; fi
